definition_en: Share of the block's units that are big flats (5-room, executive, multi-generation).
definition_zh: 该座组屋中大型单位（五房、公寓式、多代同堂）所占的比例。
why_add_en: Blocks full of big flats tend to be in newer or family-oriented estates, which affects rent.
why_add_zh: 大型单位多的组屋通常位于较新或以家庭为主的社区，会影响租金。
notes_en: 0 in 67,964 rows means the block has no big flats (a real value).
notes_zh: 67,964 行为 0，表示该座没有大型单位（是真实值）。

definition_en: The most common flat type in the block; TIED if two types share first place.
definition_zh: 该座组屋中数量最多的房型；如果两种房型并列第一则为 TIED。
why_add_en: Tells whether the block is mainly small, medium or large flats.
why_add_zh: 反映这座组屋主要是小型、中型还是大型单位。
formula: flat type with the largest unit count (1-ROOM ... EXECUTIVE); TIED if several share the max
notes_en: Studio apartments count as 2-ROOM, multi-generation as EXECUTIVE. 10,275 rows are TIED.
notes_zh: 小型公寓（studio）归入二房，多代同堂归入公寓式。10,275 行为 TIED。

definition_en: Share of the block taken by its most common flat type (1 = every unit is the same type).
definition_zh: 数量最多的房型占该座的比例（1 = 全部单位同一房型）。
why_add_en: Separates uniform blocks from mixed blocks.
why_add_zh: 区分单一房型的组屋和混合房型的组屋。

definition_en: Average number of units on each storey.
definition_zh: 每层楼平均的单位数量。
why_add_en: Few units per floor (point blocks) usually feel more private than long corridor blocks.
why_add_zh: 每层单位少（点式组屋）通常比长走廊式组屋更有隐私。
notes_en: block_max_floor may include non-residential levels, so this is approximate.
notes_zh: 最高楼层可能包括非住宅楼层，所以是近似值。

definition_en: Units per floor, but only for blocks with shops or commercial use (0 otherwise).
definition_zh: 每层单位数，只在有商业用途的组屋才有值（否则为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets the effect of block density differ for blocks with shops downstairs.
why_add_zh: 让“楼下有商店”的组屋的密度效果可以不同。
notes_en: Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Number of months since January 2021 (Jan 2021 = 0).
definition_zh: 从 2021 年 1 月起算的月数（2021 年 1 月 = 0）。
why_add_en: One simple time index for the rent trend, which rose about 50% between 2021 and 2024.
why_add_zh: 用一个简单的时间指标表示租金趋势（2021 至 2024 年上涨约 50%）。
notes_en: Use INSTEAD of rent_year + rent_month, not together (using all three made results worse in testing).
notes_zh: 请用它来取代 rent_year + rent_month，不要三个一起用（测试中一起用效果变差）。

definition_en: Extra metres to the nearest MRT exit compared with the nearest MRT/LRT exit.
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 出口比到最近 MRT/LRT 出口多出的距离（米）。
why_add_en: Shows blocks that have an LRT at the door but a longer trip to the MRT.
why_add_zh: 找出门口有轻轨（LRT）、但到地铁（MRT）较远的组屋。
notes_en: 0 in 179,319 rows means the nearest rail exit is already MRT. The source columns are in metres despite "_km".
notes_zh: 179,319 行为 0，表示最近的出口就是 MRT。原始距离字段虽然叫 _km，实际单位是米。

definition_en: Rail access group: MRT within 400m, MRT within 800m, LRT within 400m, or other.
definition_zh: 铁路便利程度分组：400 米内有 MRT、800 米内有 MRT、400 米内有 LRT，或其他。
why_add_en: Easy-to-explain grouping of MRT/LRT access for charts and linear models.
why_add_zh: 容易解释的 MRT/LRT 便利程度分组，适合图表和线性模型。
formula: first match: MRT<=400m -> MRT_400; MRT<=800m -> MRT_800; rail<=400m -> RAIL_400; else OTHER_ACCESS
notes_en: Thresholds (400m / 800m) are rules of thumb.
notes_zh: 400 米 / 800 米是经验值。

definition_en: Number of extra MRT stations that are 400–800m away.
definition_zh: 距离 400 至 800 米之间的额外 MRT 站数量。
why_add_en: Having a second station a short walk away gives more route choices.
why_add_zh: 步行不远还有第二个站，出行选择更多。

definition_en: Flat type and town combined into one label, e.g. "4-ROOM | BISHAN".
definition_zh: 房型和市镇合并成一个标签，例如 "4-ROOM | BISHAN"。
why_add_en: The rent gap between flat types differs by town.
why_add_zh: 不同房型之间的租金差距在不同市镇会不一样。
notes_en: 134 combinations; 11 have fewer than 30 rows. Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 共 134 个组合，其中 11 个少于 30 行。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Distance to the nearest MRT in km, only for 2-ROOM flats (0 for other flat types).
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 的距离（公里），只对二房单位有值（其他房型为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets MRT distance matter more for some flat types than others.
why_add_zh: 让 MRT 距离对不同房型有不同的影响。
notes_en: The 1-ROOM version was dropped (only 61 rows). Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 一房版本已删除（只有 61 行）。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Distance to the nearest MRT in km, only for 3-ROOM flats (0 for other flat types).
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 的距离（公里），只对三房单位有值（其他房型为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets MRT distance matter more for some flat types than others.
why_add_zh: 让 MRT 距离对不同房型有不同的影响。
notes_en: The 1-ROOM version was dropped (only 61 rows). Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 一房版本已删除（只有 61 行）。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Distance to the nearest MRT in km, only for 4-ROOM flats (0 for other flat types).
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 的距离（公里），只对四房单位有值（其他房型为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets MRT distance matter more for some flat types than others.
why_add_zh: 让 MRT 距离对不同房型有不同的影响。
notes_en: The 1-ROOM version was dropped (only 61 rows). Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 一房版本已删除（只有 61 行）。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Distance to the nearest MRT in km, only for 5-ROOM flats (0 for other flat types).
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 的距离（公里），只对五房单位有值（其他房型为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets MRT distance matter more for some flat types than others.
why_add_zh: 让 MRT 距离对不同房型有不同的影响。
notes_en: The 1-ROOM version was dropped (only 61 rows). Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 一房版本已删除（只有 61 行）。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Distance to the nearest MRT in km, only for EXECUTIVE flats (0 for other flat types).
definition_zh: 到最近 MRT 的距离（公里），只对公寓式单位有值（其他房型为 0）。
why_add_en: Lets MRT distance matter more for some flat types than others.
why_add_zh: 让 MRT 距离对不同房型有不同的影响。
notes_en: The 1-ROOM version was dropped (only 61 rows). Mainly for linear models; tree models find this pattern themselves.
notes_zh: 一房版本已删除（只有 61 行）。主要用于线性模型；树模型可以自己学到这个关系。

definition_en: Median rent of the same flat type over the previous 3 months.
definition_zh: 同一房型在过去 3 个月的租金中位数。
why_add_en: Tells the model the current market price level; rents rose about 50% from 2021 to 2024.
why_add_zh: 告诉模型当前的市场租金水平；2021 至 2024 年租金上涨约 50%。
formula: median(monthly_rent) of same flat_type, months m-3 to m-1
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). Blank in 3,232 rows (1.54%: Jan 2021 + 14 one-room rows) because there is no earlier month; filled with the nearest later month's value of the same flat type (for Jan 2021 that is the Jan 2021 median). Filled rows are flagged in market_level_filled.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。有 3,232 行（1.54%：2021 年 1 月 + 14 行一房）因为没有更早的月份而为空；已用同一房型最近的下一个月份的值填补（2021 年 1 月即用该月的中位数）。填补的行在 market_level_filled 中标记。

definition_en: Median rent of the same town and flat type over the previous 6 months.
definition_zh: 同一市镇、同一房型在过去 6 个月的租金中位数。
why_add_en: Local market level; some towns rose faster than others.
why_add_zh: 本地市场水平；有些市镇的租金涨得比较快。
formula: median(monthly_rent) of same town & flat_type, months m-6 to m-1; if fewer than 10 rentals, use ft_median_rent_lag3m
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). Blank in 3,232 rows (1.54%: Jan 2021 + 14 one-room rows) because there is no earlier month; filled with the nearest later month's value of the same flat type (for Jan 2021 that is the Jan 2021 median). Filled rows are flagged in market_level_filled.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。有 3,232 行（1.54%：2021 年 1 月 + 14 行一房）因为没有更早的月份而为空；已用同一房型最近的下一个月份的值填补（2021 年 1 月即用该月的中位数）。填补的行在 market_level_filled 中标记。

definition_en: How much more (+) or less (−) this block and flat type has rented for in the past than the market, after adjusting for the month. 0.10 ≈ 10% above market.
definition_zh: 这座组屋的同一房型过去比市场贵（+）或便宜（−）多少，已按月份调整。0.10 约等于比市场高 10%。
why_add_en: Captures block qualities not in the data (view, condition, nearby shops) in one number.
why_add_zh: 用一个数字概括数据中没有的组屋特点（景观、屋况、附近商店）。
formula: sum(log(rent) - log(same-month flat-type median)) over past rentals / (count + 3)
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). 0 in 18,341 rows = no history yet, so assume market level. The "+3" pulls blocks with few rentals toward 0.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。18,341 行为 0 = 还没有历史，所以假设等于市场水平。“+3”会把租赁次数少的组屋拉向 0。

definition_en: Number of past rentals of this block and flat type.
definition_zh: 这座组屋同一房型过去的租赁次数。
why_add_en: Tells the model how much to trust block_ft_past_premium.
why_add_zh: 告诉模型 block_ft_past_premium 有多可靠。
formula: count of past rentals with same address_key & flat_type
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). 0 in 17,052 rows = first time this block and flat type appears.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。17,052 行为 0 = 这座组屋的这个房型第一次出现。

definition_en: Same idea as block_ft_past_premium, for all flats on the same street.
definition_zh: 与 block_ft_past_premium 相同的概念，但针对同一条街的所有单位。
why_add_en: Backup location signal for blocks with few past rentals.
why_add_zh: 当组屋本身租赁记录少时，提供后备的地点信息。
formula: sum(log-rent gap) of past rentals on same street_name / (count + 10)
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). 0 in 3,396 rows (mostly Jan 2021) = no history yet.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。3,396 行为 0（大多是 2021 年 1 月）= 还没有历史。

definition_en: Same idea, for all flats whose nearest exit is the same MRT/LRT station.
definition_zh: 相同的概念，针对最近出口属于同一 MRT/LRT 站的所有单位。
why_add_en: Turns the station name into one number for "how popular is this station area".
why_add_zh: 把车站名称变成一个数字，表示“这个车站周边有多受欢迎”。
formula: sum(log-rent gap) of past rentals near same station / (count + 20)
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). Station codes CC30, CC31, CC9, DT4, NE18 are mapped to Keppel, Cantonment, Paya Lebar, Hume, Punggol Coast.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。车站代码 CC30、CC31、CC9、DT4、NE18 已对应到 Keppel、Cantonment、Paya Lebar、Hume、Punggol Coast。

definition_en: A simple rent estimate in SGD: market level × block premium.
definition_zh: 简单的租金估计（新元）：市场水平 × 组屋溢价。
why_add_en: The single strongest new column (correlation with rent 0.77); a good baseline prediction.
why_add_zh: 最强的新字段（与租金相关系数 0.77）；本身就是不错的基准预测。
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). Filled rows use the filled ft_median_rent_lag3m.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。填补的行使用已填补的 ft_median_rent_lag3m。

definition_en: First two digits of the postal code (57 areas).
definition_zh: 邮区编号的前两位数（57 个区域）。
why_add_en: Finer location than town (27 towns), so big towns can be split into parts.
why_add_zh: 比市镇（27 个）更细的地点，可以把大市镇再分区。
notes_en: Read as text: pd.read_csv(..., dtype={"postal_sector": str}), else "05" becomes 5.
notes_zh: 请以文字读取：pd.read_csv(..., dtype={"postal_sector": str})，否则 "05" 会变成 5。

definition_en: Singapore URA postal district D01–D28.
definition_zh: 新加坡市建局（URA）邮区 D01–D28。
why_add_en: The standard Singapore location grouping; easy to explain.
why_add_zh: 新加坡标准的地区划分；方便解释。
notes_en: Mostly repeats postal_sector for tree models.
notes_zh: 对树模型来说与 postal_sector 大部分重复。

definition_en: 1 if the town is an HDB mature estate, else 0.
definition_zh: 如果市镇是建屋局成熟市镇则为 1，否则为 0。
why_add_en: Mature estates have more established amenities and are usually more central.
why_add_zh: 成熟市镇的设施较完善，通常也比较靠近市中心。
formula: town in {ANG MO KIO, BEDOK, BISHAN, BUKIT MERAH, BUKIT TIMAH, CENTRAL, CLEMENTI, GEYLANG, KALLANG/WHAMPOA, MARINE PARADE, PASIR RIS, QUEENSTOWN, SERANGOON, TAMPINES, TOA PAYOH}
notes_en: Repeats town for tree models; useful for linear models and charts.
notes_zh: 对树模型来说与 town 重复；适合线性模型和图表。

definition_en: Planning region: Central, East, North, North-East or West.
definition_zh: 规划区域：中部、东部、北部、东北部或西部。
why_add_en: Simple location grouping for linear models and charts.
why_add_zh: 简单的地区分组，适合线性模型和图表。
notes_en: Repeats town for tree models.
notes_zh: 对树模型来说与 town 重复。

definition_en: 1 if the nearest rail is LRT and the nearest MRT is more than 800m away.
definition_zh: 如果最近的铁路是 LRT，而最近的 MRT 超过 800 米，则为 1。
why_add_en: Blocks that rely on the LRT (Sengkang, Punggol, Bukit Panjang) may rent for less.
why_add_zh: 依赖轻轨的组屋（盛港、榜鹅、武吉班让）租金可能较低。

definition_en: How close the block is to MRT compared with other blocks in the same town (0 = closest, 1 = farthest).
definition_zh: 与同市镇其他组屋相比，这座组屋离 MRT 有多近（0 = 最近，1 = 最远）。
why_add_en: Tenants compare within a town: 600m is close in Tengah but far in Toa Payoh.
why_add_zh: 租户通常在同一市镇内比较：600 米在登加算近，在大巴窑就算远。
formula: percentile rank of dist_nearest_mrt_km among unique blocks in the town
notes_en: Ranked over unique blocks, not rental rows.
notes_zh: 按不重复的组屋排名，而不是按租赁记录。

definition_en: Approximate years left on the 99-year lease.
definition_zh: 99 年地契大约还剩多少年。
why_add_en: Easier to explain than age; tenants tend to avoid very old blocks.
why_add_zh: 比屋龄更容易解释；租户一般会避开很旧的组屋。
notes_en: Same information as building_age — use one, not both.
notes_zh: 与 building_age 信息相同——二选一。

definition_en: Decade the block was completed: <1980, 1980s, 1990s, 2000s, 2010+.
why_add_en: Flat size and layout differ by build generation, and the data has no floor area.
why_add_zh: 不同年代的单位面积和格局不同，而数据中没有面积。
notes_en: Stays fixed for a block over time (age does not).
notes_zh: 对同一座组屋不会随时间改变（屋龄会）。

definition_en: Years older (+) or newer (−) than the typical block in the same town.
definition_zh: 比同市镇一般组屋老（+）或新（−）多少年。
why_add_en: A new block in an old town stands out; a new block in Punggol does not.
why_add_zh: 老市镇里的新组屋比较突出；榜鹅的新组屋则很普通。
formula: building_age - median(building_age of unique blocks in same town and year)

definition_en: How tall the block is compared with other blocks in the same town (0 = lowest, 1 = tallest).
definition_zh: 与同市镇其他组屋相比这座组屋有多高（0 = 最矮，1 = 最高）。
why_add_en: Taller blocks usually have better views; the data has no floor level for the unit.
why_add_zh: 较高的组屋通常景观较好；数据中没有单位所在楼层。
formula: percentile rank of block_max_floor among unique blocks in the town

definition_en: Total units of this flat type across all blocks in the town.
definition_zh: 该市镇所有组屋中这个房型的单位总数。
why_add_en: Supply: more flats of the same type nearby means more competing listings.
why_add_zh: 供应量：附近同房型越多，竞争的出租单位越多。
formula: sum(block_units_this_flat_type) over unique blocks in same town & flat_type
notes_en: Only counts blocks that appear in the rental data. 0 in 4 rows (1-ROOM in Pasir Ris / Choa Chu Kang).
notes_zh: 只计算出现在租赁数据中的组屋。4 行为 0（巴西立 / 蔡厝港的一房）。

definition_en: Number of rentals in the same block in the previous 12 months.
definition_zh: 同一座组屋在过去 12 个月的租赁次数。
why_add_en: Busy rental blocks (near universities or industrial areas) can price differently.
why_add_zh: 出租活跃的组屋（靠近大学或工业区）租金可能不同。
formula: count of rows with same address_key in months m-12 to m-1
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage). 0 = no rentals in the past year.
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。0 = 过去一年没有出租记录。

definition_en: Share of the block rented out over the past 12 months.
definition_zh: 过去 12 个月这座组屋被出租的单位比例。
why_add_en: Makes rental activity comparable between big and small blocks.
why_add_zh: 让大座和小座组屋的出租活跃度可以比较。
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage).
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。

definition_en: Number of rentals of the same town and flat type in the previous 3 months.
definition_zh: 同市镇、同房型在过去 3 个月的租赁数量。
why_add_en: Local market activity; a jump can mean more supply.
why_add_zh: 本地市场活跃度；数量突然增加可能代表供应变多。
formula: count of rows with same town & flat_type in months m-3 to m-1
notes_en: Uses only rentals from months BEFORE this row (no leakage).
notes_zh: 只使用该行月份之前的租赁记录（不会泄露答案）。

definition_en: Flat type as a number of rooms: 1-ROOM = 1 … EXECUTIVE = 6.
definition_zh: 房型转成数字：一房 = 1 … 公寓式 = 6。
why_add_en: Lets linear models use the size order of flat types.
why_add_zh: 让线性模型能使用房型的大小顺序。
notes_en: Same information as flat_type — use one in linear models.
notes_zh: 与 flat_type 信息相同——线性模型二选一。

definition_en: 1 if the block has no recorded units of the rented flat type.
definition_zh: 如果该组屋没有记录这个出租房型的单位，则为 1。
why_add_en: Flags 179 rows where the rental record and property data disagree.
why_add_zh: 标出 179 行租赁记录与房产数据不一致的情况。
notes_en: Check these rows by hand; consider excluding them.
notes_zh: 建议人工检查这些行，可考虑排除。

definition_en: 1 if ft_median_rent_lag3m, town_ft_median_rent_lag6m and expected_rent_block_ft were filled because there was no earlier history.
definition_zh: 如果 ft_median_rent_lag3m、town_ft_median_rent_lag6m 和 expected_rent_block_ft 因为没有更早的历史而被填补，则为 1。
why_add_en: Keeps track of which values are filled, so the model and analysts can tell them apart.
why_add_zh: 记录哪些数值是填补的，让模型和分析人员可以区分。
